resources.string: Lets Buddy AI read what is on the screen and tap, type and scroll for you when you give it a voice command. Screen contents are sent to the AI provider you choose in the Buddy AI app.
Buddy AI closed unexpectedly last time. Sharing the report helps get it fixed.
Try “%1$s, text Mum I’m on my way”
Turn Buddy AI on to start listening
Buddy AI still needs: %1$s. Tap to finish setup.
Buddy AI needs microphone permission first.
Voice: George (British male) is the default Kokoro voice
Needs an internet connection. If the voice can\'t be reached, Buddy AI uses Kokoro or the phone\'s voice instead.
Start when the phone turns on
Talk over Buddy, or say \"stop\", and it stops and listens. Keeps the microphone on while it speaks, with echo cancellation.
For a few seconds after answering, you can carry on without repeating the wake word.
Things Buddy should know about you
e.g. My mother is saved as \"Amma\" in WhatsApp
One per line, e.g. WhatsApp: the search icon is at the top right
Show the task island at the top while Buddy works
Add an English phrase to use alongside Hey Buddy. Clear it to use the default.
Use English letters and spaces, up to 40 characters.
Download the Kokoro voice first. Playing the system voice for now.
On this phone Kokoro takes %1$.1f seconds to make each second of speech, so it pauses between phrases. A cloud voice or the phone\'s own voice won\'t pause.
Get a key at platform.openai.com → API keys. If you\'ve added an OpenAI model, its key is used automatically.
alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, fable, onyx, nova, sage, shimmer or verse
Get a key at elevenlabs.io → Developers → API keys.
A voice ID from your ElevenLabs voice library. The default is George, a warm British voice.
Get a key at fish.audio → API keys.
The ID of a voice on fish.audio (open the voice and copy the ID from its page). Leave empty for the default voice.
Any server with an OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint, such as Kokoro-FastAPI on your computer. A key is optional.
The voice name your server expects.
Let cloud AI see my memories
Remember what tasks I have done
Use the on-device model built into Buddy AI
Allow the model download on mobile data
This build has no on-device runtime. The model in Termux or your cloud models are used instead.
On-device model: installed. It starts when needed and stops after a while to save memory.
The on-device model (about 1 GB) is not downloaded yet.
No on-phone model is set up. Add one on the Models page, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1.
On-phone model (%1$s): not running. Buddy AI starts it through Termux when needed.
Short, simple questions use the model on your phone. Complex reasoning or search uses cloud models when online.
Cloud models first, the on-phone model if the internet is down.
Only the on-phone model answers. Nothing leaves your phone.
Offline recognition on your phone. English only.
Buddy AI uses your active model. Tap a model to edit it or activate it.
Add Claude, OpenAI, xAI Grok, Gemini, Groq, or a model running on your computer with LM Studio or Ollama.
If the primary model can\'t be reached (offline, out of credit, server down), Buddy AI carries on with your other models, top to bottom.
Effort: lower is faster, higher is more careful
Buddy AI will stop using this model.
Get an API key at console.anthropic.com → API Keys. Low effort makes phone tasks noticeably faster.
Get an API key at platform.openai.com → API keys. Use any model that supports tool calling.
Get an API key at console.x.ai → API Keys. Supports grok-beta and grok-2.

On your computer: open LM Studio → Developer → start the server and turn on \"Serve on Local Network\". Enter your computer\'s IP address below and load a model that supports tool calling (e.g. Qwen).
On your computer, start Ollama with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 so the phone can reach it, then enter your computer\'s IP address below. Use a model that supports tool calling.
Get an API key at openrouter.ai/keys. Use any model ID listed on the site.
Get an API key at aistudio.google.com → Get API key.
Get an API key at console.groq.com/keys.
Any server with an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint and tool calling.
Please enter your API key first.
Go to the app without activating
I can run your phone for you. Say \"Hey Buddy\" and tell me what you need: send a message, open an app, change a setting.\n\nLet\'s get me set up. It takes about two minutes.
I need the microphone to hear \"Hey Buddy\" and your commands. Listening for the wake word happens entirely on your phone.

To tap, type and scroll for you, Android needs you to switch on Buddy AI in Accessibility settings:

1. Tap Open settings below
2. Find Installed apps (or Downloaded apps)
3. Tap Buddy AI phone control and switch it on
Greyed out or says \"Restricted setting\"? Open Buddy AI\'s app info, tap ⋮ in the top corner, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.

Allow Buddy AI to run in the background so I can still hear \"Hey Buddy\" when your screen is off.\n\nOn Vivo, Samsung, Xiaomi and other phones, also set Buddy AI\'s battery setting to \"Unrestricted\".

Three mandatory voice components running entirely offline on your phone: the \"Hey Buddy\" detector, speech recognition for commands, and Kokoro neural speech synthesis. Provisioning requires an initial download.
Choose the AI that does the thinking: Groq, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, or a model on your own computer with LM Studio or Ollama.
I\'ll think with %1$s. You can add more models and change the active one on the Models page.
Say \"Hey Buddy\" any time, or tap the mic in the app. Try: \"Hey Buddy, open Spotify\" or \"Hey Buddy, increase the volume.\"
So Buddy AI can hear you
Lets Buddy AI tap, type and scroll for you
Keeps Buddy listening with the screen off
Tap \"Installed apps\" (or \"Downloaded apps\"), then \"Buddy AI phone control\", and switch it on.
Find Buddy AI in the list and set it to \"Don\'t optimise\" or \"Unrestricted\".
Tap a task to review each step. Hold a task to delete it.
Things you asked Buddy AI to remember, and app names you taught it. Tap a note to edit it, hold any row to delete it. They stay on this phone.
Nothing saved yet. Try saying: \"Hey Buddy, remember that I prefer short answers.\"
Delete all saved tasks and their steps?
Delete everything Buddy AI remembers? This cannot be undone.
No steps were recorded for this task.
